items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you mean Milton Buckner? [INTERVIEWEE] His brother – –

ctx.x: That was in Detroit. That was in Detroit on Adams Street. Now that was a big band. Glitzy, the leader of it was a saxophone player who is the brother of a pianist. He played block chords. He was the one that originated the block chord structure.
